content.title: MLB - Apps on Google Play
content.text: The MLB App is the #1 destination for live baseball video and audio, breaking news, trade rumors, scores, standings, and more, directly on your Android device. Stream live or on-demand!WATCH & LISTEN, FREE-- The Watch experience has 24/7 personalized programming, curated content collections and the deepest baseball-on-demand video library anywhere-- Watch free in-game, real-time highlights for every game-- Watch select Minor League Baseball games-- MLB Film Room: Search millions of videos-- Picture-in-Picture streaming for live video and highlights-- Watch MLB Network programming (pay TV authentication required)SUBSCRIBERS GET MORE-- Stream MLB Network 24/7 on the MLB app-- Listen to Home, Away and Spanish-language (where available) radio broadcasts live and on demand with MLB At Bat-- Watch 7,000+ Minor League Baseball games with MLB+-- Universal audio support for MLB+ subscribers, accessible on iPhone, iPad and other supported smartphones and tabletsFOLLOW TEAMS & PLAYERS-- Follow specific players for daily video, stats and content tailored to your preferences-- The Home feed is everything you want on one screen: your favorite team’s snapshot, personalized content, tickets and real-time news & highlights-- Set your favorite team and follow others for a more personalized experienceNOW ON ANDROID XR-- Watch highlights and clips in Spatial 3D-- Immersive Ballparks with Gameday 3D Live and On-demand Games-- Multitask on device with the Shared Space video playerGO DEEP-- New Browse menu makes it easy to explore, including Prospects, Baseball Savant, Tickets, Shop and seasonal sections-- New Account management makes it easy to curate your followed player lists, manage notifications and link your subscriptions-- Enhanced scoreboard tells you where to watch every game-- Gameday has more stats, pitch-by-pitch features and data visualizations-- Breaking news, schedules, interactive rosters and player stats for every team-- Sortable batting, pitching and fielding statisticsPrivacy Policy: mlb.com/privacyTerms of Use: mlb.com/tou© 2026 MLB Advanced Media, L.P.
